description: Agent Operations: submit merchant page or checkout material as pasted (product page text, checkout summary, shipping text, returns text). The signed report says whether an agent can determine, from that material alone, the final price with shipping and tax where stated, the stock or availability, the delivery estimate and the return policy, each marked determinable, ambiguous or absent with the deciding text quoted, plus the question to settle for each open point. Analysis of supplied text: live probing of an endpoint is wever_endpoint-reliability-check. Verdict terms_absent, terms_ambiguous or all_determinable. POST /api/checkout-clarity-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-operations-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-operations/.
